title: Compressed Materials
description: Ever hated that even with the additions of bundles and shulker boxes, your inventory is always filled with many stacks of stuff.
body:
# Description
Ever hated that even with the additions of bundles and shulker boxes, your inventory is always filled with many stacks of stuff. well... with Compressed Materials, this wont be an issue. the datapack will allow you to turn items with a count of 64 in to a 1 item and back.

## Video Showcase:
[Compressed Materials: Showcase](https://youtu.be/BCAOvinPerE)

## Notes:
This does **NOT** work with custom items or items containing specific nbt data, but some modded items will work.

### Comments:
Well? Did you like it?, Consider checking my other Projects!
- [Way too many Datapacks!](https://modrinth.com/collection/aqrbm311)
